aide.meta_desc: Find answers to your questions about Bonemia: subscriptions, payments, account and security.
aide.hero_sub: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions about Bonemia.
aide.a_what_is_bonemia: Bonemia is a platform that gives you access to 30+ premium subscriptions (Netflix, Spotify, ChatGPT…) by sharing costs with other verified members. Save up to 75% on your favourite digital subscriptions.
aide.a_how_safe: Safety is our obsession. All members are verified, payments are encrypted, and we never share your personal information. Every group is managed under strict rules to guarantee a reliable experience.
aide.a_who_can_join: Any adult with a valid payment method can create an account. Bonemia is accessible from most French-speaking and English-speaking countries.
aide.a_which_services: We offer 30+ services: Netflix, Spotify, ChatGPT Plus, Claude, Disney+, YouTube Premium, Adobe Creative Cloud, and many more. The catalog grows regularly.
aide.q_how_to_access: How do I access a subscription?
aide.a_how_to_access: Choose a service from our catalog, join an existing group or create your own, complete your payment, and get immediate access to your service. Everything happens in 3 simple steps.
aide.q_cancel_anytime: Can I cancel at any time?
aide.a_cancel_anytime: Yes. You can leave a group or cancel your subscription at any time from your personal dashboard. Access remains active until the end of the period already paid for.
aide.a_share_account: Bonemia fully manages group coordination for you. You don't need to worry about the technical details — we handle everything to ensure your access is smooth and reliable.
aide.a_payment_methods: We accept bank cards (Visa, Mastercard), mobile payments (Orange Money, Wave, MTN) and other local methods depending on your country.
aide.a_refund: If you experience a technical issue attributable to Bonemia within 48 hours of your payment, we will issue a full refund. Contact our support team with the details of your situation.
aide.a_billing_cycle: Billing is monthly. You receive a summary by email before each renewal. No hidden fees — the displayed price is the final price.
aide.q_change_password: How do I change my password?
aide.a_change_password: Go to Settings → Security from your dashboard. You can also reset your password from the login page via "Forgot password".
aide.q_delete_account: How do I delete my account?
aide.a_delete_account: You can request account deletion from Settings → My account → Delete my account. This action is irreversible and all your data will be erased within 30 days.
aide.q_multiple_devices: Can I use Bonemia on multiple devices?
aide.a_multiple_devices: Your Bonemia account is accessible from any browser. The number of devices allowed for each service depends on the service itself (Netflix, Spotify…) and the group type.
aide.contact_sub: Our team replies within 24 hours. Describe your issue and we'll do our best to help.
aide.contact_sent: Message sent! We'll reply within 24 hours.
